name: m0irai
description: m0irai — a terminal room that runs Claude, Codex, and Gemini (Antigravity) as one team of coding agents: persistent agent sessions, mechanical quality gates, and a SQLite evidence ledger.
author: CodeZero

scripts.build: node scripts/clean-dist.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.production.json && node scripts/copy-evidence-schema.mjs
scripts.build:all: node scripts/clean-dist.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/copy-evidence-schema.mjs
scripts.lint: biome check . && node scripts/gate-agent-files.mjs && node scripts/gate-clamps.mjs && node scripts/gate-encoding.mjs && node scripts/gate-no-claude-p.mjs && node scripts/gate-patches.mjs && node scripts/gate-scripts-scope.mjs && node scripts/gate-hermetic-seams.mjs
scripts.gates: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npx biome check . && node scripts/gate-agent-files.mjs && node scripts/gate-clamps.mjs && node scripts/gate-encoding.mjs && node scripts/gate-no-claude-p.mjs && node scripts/gate-patches.mjs && node scripts/gate-scripts-scope.mjs && node scripts/gate-hermetic-seams.mjs && node scripts/gate-l5-mandates.mjs && npm run dep-check && npm run dead-code && node scripts/gate-cut-closure.mjs && node scripts/gate-tracked-surface.mjs && node scripts/gate-oracle-registration.mjs && node scripts/gate-reachability.mjs && npm test && npm run test:integration && node scripts/oracle-standalone.mjs && node scripts/oracle-standalone.mjs --falsify schema && node scripts/oracle-standalone.mjs --falsify digest-entry && node scripts/gate-reachability.mjs --falsify
scripts.verify: npm run gates && npm run verify:rust
